_comment: ADR-037 register fragment — source-secrets-writeonly (ocon#147 phase 2, openregister#380). SECURITY FIX. Phase 1 (#152) locked the `source` schema to admin-only; this phase marks its plaintext credential fields `writeOnly: true` so OpenRegister's render boundary (or#386) strips them from EVERY API response — even an admin's, even the generic object API, even the @self.relations index copy. A field the server never returns cannot leak, whoever reads it. The engine is unaffected: it reads a source's credential via getObject() in system context (CallService::$source->getObject(), _rbac:false), which the redaction never touches. Delivered as a fragment, not a base-register edit, because re-parsing the monolith trips a pre-existing SchemaMapper $ref-resolution bug; the fragment deep-merges writeOnly into each property object without touching its type/description/title. The old descriptions claimed the fields were 'plaintext per ADR-007' — wrong twice: ADR-007 is i18n, and plaintext-readable was exactly the leak. Longer term, prefer configuration.authentication.credentialRef (the broker) so no secret is embedded on the source at all (BrokeredCallService already makes credentialRef the safe path, sibling embedded secrets a hard 409).
